name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands just wider than shoulder width on the edge of a sturdy bench and step back into a straight plank.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips aligned with your shoulders.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso to lower your chest smoothly toward the edge of the bench.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
tips: Lower your chest rather than your face toward the bench edge.
Keep your body rigid from head to heels without letting your lower back arch.
